senses.gloss: m. (Isp. or Ithpe. of קוטל = גודל thumb) snapping with thumb and middle finger, flipping.
units: <cite ref="Taanit 25a:14">Taan. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>טרק לי בא׳ אאפותי</he> Ar. (ed. <he>מחיין … אפו׳</he>; Ms. M. <he>אאפותאי</he>) he stirred me up by snapping on my forehead.—Pl. <he>אִסְקוּטְלֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 28a:15">Ab. Zar. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>מחייה שתין אס׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>אית׳</he>) snap thereon (on the swelling) sixty times.
